frozen_input.generic_complex: C_gen, the source-labelled generic five-pole twisted de Rham complex

open_square.commutator_type: closed degree-zero morphism in the derived Hom complex

typing_requirements: generic five-pole complex and differential are explicit
pi and i are explicit and form a Cartesian square on the stated locus
all four derived functors have declared source and target categories
normal labels remain distinct through I^2/I^3
comparison is formed before taking ranks, determinants, or Q-valuations
any nullhomotopy is an explicit source-derived homotopy compatible with the differential

accepted_outcomes.strict: the two derived chain maps agree
accepted_outcomes.homotopy: their difference is d_Hom-exact with an explicit admissible homotopy
accepted_outcomes.obstructed: their difference represents a nonzero derived-Hom class with located support
accepted_outcomes.untyped: one of the complexes, functors, comparison maps, or categories is absent

inadmissible_inferences: chain-level localization commutation implies derived proper base change
post-hoc saturation or fitted quotient supplies the missing cell
collapse of the three labelled normal directions before comparison
a Q factor in an arbitrary matrix coordinate is intrinsic support

Q_gate.open_only_after: beta_GM is typed and its cone or obstruction class is computed
intrinsic_tests: support or annihilator of the obstruction cohomology
Fitting ideals of a presentation proved independent of choices
valuation of invariant minors after bases and lattices are frozen

specialist_escalation: Invoke a filtered-derived or nearby-cycle specialist only after the four corners and chain maps exist and the remaining ambiguity is realization of beta_GM.
